title: Tile blueprint
description: A kind of tile a region is made of (#116): its look and its traits. One file per kind, named after its id; a region's legend places it by its id.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

model.description: A decoration drawn on every tile of this kind: a res:// path to a model under assets/.

traits.description: What the kind does in the game.

walkable.description: Whether walkers can stand on it.
